Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd., headquartered at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China, is a renowned innovator and manufacturer in the field of specialty chemicals and new materials. Established with a vision to drive industrial and technological advancements, the company has earned a trusted reputation both domestically and internationally. As a key player in China’s vibrant chemical industry, Zhejiang Runhe focuses on research, development, production, and sales of high-performance chemical products designed to meet the evolving demands of a diverse range of industries, including textiles, personal care, pharmaceuticals, electronics, and construction.

The company is particularly celebrated for its expertise in silicone-based materials and textile chemicals, providing sustainable and efficient solutions to global partners. Its state-of-the-art R&D facilities and professional team of scientists and engineers drive consistent innovation, ensuring products adhere to the strictest standards of quality, safety, and environmental stewardship.

Committed to sustainable development, Zhejiang Runhe integrates green chemistry principles into its production processes, aiming to minimize environmental impact while maximizing product performance. By fostering long-term partnerships and prioritizing effective customer service, the company remains at the forefront of a competitive global marketplace. Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. stands as a reliable partner for businesses seeking cutting-edge chemical solutions backed by technological excellence and sustainable practices.
